prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Full SCENE STATE SHEET for a physical Mars expedition game. Match the supplied realistic painterly cream-and-teal machinery, ochre landscape, restrained cobalt science equipment, mustard rover fittings. Locally made parts are simple cut straight steel and bolted joints, never elaborate molded industrial machinery. Factory precision parts are imported. No people, text, numerals, labels, captions, borders, arrows, diagrams or UI. Each panel repeats EXACTLY the same camera, framing, object positions, light, room/landscape and perspective, changing ONLY the specified state. Every recurring object is the same actual object. Frame the full installation in the upper two thirds; lower third is quiet natural floor or ground for the movable inventory. No loose decorative objects. Whole scenes will be cropped into registered fixed targets; keep independent working regions clearly separated. Square panels, not portrait strips.
Layout: 3 columns by 1 rows of equal SQUARE scenes. Reading order left to right then next row. A modest industrial worksite on level red ground outside the cave farm, set apart from the habitation. Background includes the small existing station array and rounded cream habitat far away. The new working footprint has TWO neighboring parts: larger left part for delivered photovoltaic expansion modules and a smaller EMPTY right concrete-free bolted-equipment footing for later process frame. No future reactor, gas tanks or radiator before built.
STATE 1: Unprepared shallow dusty plot with scattered loose stones. No expansion array or footing.
STATE 2: Loose infill cleared and ground graded. Simple compacted ground and checked flat ceramic footing blocks define the left array area and a smaller empty right equipment pad.
STATE 3: Delivered photovoltaic expansion modules stand on simple straight bolted supports in the LEFT part. The smaller RIGHT equipment pad remains clearly EMPTY for later construction. The original little station array stays far in the background.
